email.subject1: a signal play for Incredible Health
email.body1:
John, saw Incredible Health crossed 1.5M nurses and launched Gale and Lyn, cutting hiring times to under 20 days.

Growth and momentum like that surface more in-market healthcare employers than the BD team can reach before they cool, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Incredible Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Incredible Health.

Reaching half the country's nurses raises employer-side targets fast, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to convert that reach into signed deals this quarter. The gap shows up late, mid-quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Incredible Health needs to hit target, and where it breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Incredible Health.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other health-tech BD teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling employer pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling AI voice agents across hospitals is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a healthcare BD motion? I will tailor it to Incredible Health either way.
